design_decisions: ExecutionRequest carries bound executable SQL separately from user-facing original SQL.
Catalog availability and result provenance are immutable service/window state, not inferred from current widgets.
SavedQueriesDock keeps one in-memory ID-to-record snapshot per refresh.
Every submitted request retains its launch editor as result-display owner, while a separate origin label rejects ordering for direct saved-query results.
Catalog write failure state is retained and mirrored in the Messages panel until a successful projection save clears it.
